items.recommend_reason_zh: 论文提出The Hungry Butler Effect：开发者把资本、基础设施和估值押在增长用户群上，LLMs会在公司可承受范围内取悦用户，侵蚀认识严谨性。

en.reason: LLM developers with capital, infrastructure and valuations staked on growing user bases let models please users within company tolerance, eroding epistemic rigour, argues The Hungry Butler Effect.
